prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 多列数值 · 8 列 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 8 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 13px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "日期" · longest unbreakable word 38px · one-line width 77px
  col 2: header "开盘" · longest unbreakable word 34px · one-line width 34px
  col 3: header "最高" · longest unbreakable word 34px · one-line width 34px
  col 4: header "最低" · longest unbreakable word 34px · one-line width 34px
  col 5: header "收盘" · longest unbreakable word 34px · one-line width 34px
  col 6: header "涨跌幅" · longest unbreakable word 48px · one-line width 48px
  col 7: header "成交量（手）" · longest unbreakable word 61px · one-line width 80px
  col 8: header "成交额（万元）" · longest unbreakable word 69px · one-line width 93px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 607px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 606px.
Fixed: content, font, 13px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"按日期展示股票的价格、涨跌幅和成交情况，便于比较各交易日的行情。","reading":"读者可横向查看同一日的行情，纵向比较各日价格、涨跌幅和成交规模；每行应清楚地读作一个整体。","groups":["开盘、最高、最低、收盘都是价格，宜保持相同列宽，方便逐列比较。","成交量（手）与成交额（万元）都描述交易规模，位于表格右侧，数值较长。","涨跌幅衔接价格与成交数据，其正负号和百分号具有重要含义。"],"keep_intact":["日期及其分隔符","价格数值","带正负号和百分号的涨跌幅","带千位分隔符的成交量和成交额"],"may_wrap":["成交量（手）和成交额（万元）的表头可在文字与单位之间换行；数据行仍可保持单行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [98, 55, 55, 55, 55, 69, 101, 114] · table 603×167px · row heights [33, 33, 33, 33, 33] · column headers wrapped 0/8 · tallest cell 1 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [110, 62, 62, 62, 62, 76, 82, 90] · table 607×187px · row heights [53, 33, 33, 33, 33] · column headers wrapped 2/8 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [98, 55, 55, 55, 55, 69, 82, 90] · table 560×187px · row heights [53, 33, 33, 33, 33] · column headers wrapped 2/8 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"日期、价格、涨跌幅和成交数据均保持单行；四个价格列等宽，便于纵向比较。表头与数据行高度一致，整行行情紧凑且完整。","problems":"价格列和涨跌幅列的留白较紧，但仍能清楚辨认；整体没有明显的排版缺陷。","cause":"价格列各为55px、涨跌幅列为69px，恰好容纳最长内容及21px的内边距和边框；日期及两个成交列也达到各自的单行宽度。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"日期和价格列较宽，数值周围留白充足；四个价格列保持等宽，数据行仍为单行。","problems":"两个成交表头换行，使表头明显高于数据行；尤其成交额的单位“万元”被拆开，影响识读。价格列的额外留白也压缩了较长的成交表头。","cause":"日期列110px、四个价格列各62px，占用了较多宽度；成交量列82px、成交额列90px，分别只有61px和69px可用文本宽度，不足以容纳完整单行表头。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"四个价格列等宽，所有数据行保持单行；表格比r0B窄，右侧留有空间。","problems":"成交表头仍然换行，成交额的“万元”被拆开；表格右侧空余宽度未能用于改善表头，因此缩窄没有带来明显的阅读收益。","cause":"成交量列82px、成交额列90px，与r0B一样不足以容纳完整表头；表格总宽560px，距离606px上限还有46px。"}],"done":true,"designs":[]}
